pattern.description: Wide live-action office shot, locked-off: after his 'geese' line the colleague turns and walks off frame right while the seated pair react ('Great to know.'). No graphics animate.
pattern.why_premium: The comedic button is timed through blocking (exit plus a deadpan reaction) in a well-lit, deep-staged office set, so the scene reads like a commercial rather than a template.

build_hint.gsap: No motion-graphic build; use the footage as is. A cut-out recreation would be gsap.to(person, {x: 260, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power1.in'}) with motion blur on the exiting layer.
build_hint.remotion: <OffthreadVideo> clip; for a cut-out recreation, translateX = interpolate(frame, [0, 15], [0, 260], {easing: Easing.in(Easing.quad)}).

notes: The filmstrip frames are crops around b01, which is why the framing looks tighter than the end frame; camera.move is none. All three candidates are tonal and look like part of the score (CLAP says chime); x167 is worth a listen.
